title: プロジェクトデザイン実践(実験)(建築)
subtitle: Design Project / Implementing and Operating (Architecture)
courseType:
Practical Engineering Education Program

keywords: Inspection process 2.Effective 3.Data handling skill 4.Reliability 5.Science and technology PBL
educationalGoal: Students will:(1) learn a skill of inspection process of a hypothesis or the solution to the problem concept,(2) understand a phenomenon, an object, a phenomenon quantitatively and qualitatively,(3) tell information to a third party clearly,(4) learn various skills required for pushing forward inspection activity smoothly,(5) imagine a technical area and an engineer image to learn in architecture.
advice: Students learn how to lead processes to inspect a hypothesis or learn how to lead processes to inspect effectiveness / acceptance characteristics of the specific part among the characteristics of a concept aiming at a solution to the problem or the concept.In part students learn "a building design skill" to need data in collection → rearranging → analysis → hypothesis → visualization → report. In part "a structure design skill" to lead to the inspection, "an environmental design skill" and "an element skill of the inspection activity" are learned by the drafting of the hypothesis.(1) Building design skill:Students announce the design of a house that an individual designed in a group and narrow it down to one basic design plan based on exchange of opinions. Students make the 1/20 model of the house.(2) Structure design skill:Based on basic design plan, students examine construction and how to structure and the method of construction. Students examine examination and the transformation of the material of the Class basic axis and perform the loading experiment with the model.(3) Environmental design skill:Based on basic design plan, students perform the examination of the environmental characteristic (insulation characteristics, sound, illumination, air conditioning, ventilation) while using analysis tools.(4) Inspection activity skill: Students summarize result provided by a series of design activity in a project report and announce the team by a poster session and plan communalization of the knowledge in the whole class.
requiredKnowledge: It is desirable to have the experience that worked on design of a house in individuals as a design problem. It is desirable to learn the basics of how to write building plan. It is desirable to review the common rule including how to write dimensions, a building term and the drawing symbol that the design is a team and will wrestle.

activityGoals.body: Be able to push forward the activity of the process to lead to solution from problem discovery
Be able to catch a phenomenon, an object, a phenomenon quantitatively or qualitatively
Be able to extract characteristic, characteristic, law characteristics of a phenomenon, an object, the phenomeno
Be able to tell the information that oneself got to a third party clearly
Be able to utilize various basic skills to need if students push forward inspection activity smoothly
Be able to imagine a technical area and an engineer image to learn in architecture

achievementLevels.ideal: Using the technique that student devised by a team, students inspect solution suggestion and can evaluate it from plural viewpoints logically. Based on an evaluation result of the solution suggestion, student can review a design of the suggestion. Furthermore, student can think about social use of the solution suggestion. Student can summarize activity result in a project report in a logical sentence clearly. Student can explain activity result by a poster and a presentation clearly. Furthermore, student can cope with questions and answers appropriately.
achievementLevels.standard: Using the technique that student devised by a team, student can evaluate solution suggestion. Based on an evaluation result of the solution suggestion, student can review a design of the suggestion. Student can summarize activity result in a project report. Student can explain activity result by a poster and a presentation clearly. *Tardy and absence, the negative activity (team activity nonparticipation) deduct points of a personal acquisition point as a penalty of the action posture.

lessons.content: Guidance Team information registration. Confirmation of the class rule. Announce the introduction about the personal design of a house.
lessons.assignments: Team: Preparations for team file Inspection plan seat of the design of a house. Individual: Preparations for practice note.

lessons.content: Continuation of an introduction announcement about personal house design. The house design plan designed by a team more than a released medium house design problem is narrowed down. A team decides about an operational allotment in the team for drawing making of a proposed amendment.
lessons.assignments: Team: Summary of the design of a house plan that students chose. Individual: Practice notebook (thought for a house narrowed down)

lessons.content: Consideration of the environment special quality of the designed housing is begun. Insulation performance of an important part is considered thermally.
lessons.assignments: Team: Making of the allotment plan of the basic design. Individual: Practice notebook (activity report of the construction plan)

lessons.content: The sound insulation performance in the room and the soundproof performance of the designed housing are considered. The illumination in the private room in designed housing is considered. An environment special quality sheet in designed housing is made.
lessons.assignments: Team: Making of an environment sheet. Individual: Shared environment sheet making.

lessons.content: Structural external force in designed housing is considered. Consideration of a floor joist (I load it vertically and loads it levelly.).
lessons.assignments: Team: Consideration in a structure face Individual: Structure calculation.

lessons.content: Weight calculation in designed housing and structural improvement are proposed. Consideration of wall volume (calculation of earthquake load).
lessons.assignments: Team: Making on a structure calculation report. Individual: Structure calculation.

lessons.content: A detail in designed housing is reconsidered and a sketch is done. Making of a design point.
lessons.assignments: Team: Correction with a design, Making of a design point. Individual: Correction of a shared design plan.

lessons.content: Intention change in a design drawing and sketch in housing. A design drawing is drawn. Making of a design point.
lessons.assignments: Team: Design drawing making. Making of a design point. Individual: Consideration and making of a shared design drawing.

lessons.content: Intention change in a design drawing in housing. Making of a design drawing Poster production for middle announcements.
lessons.assignments: Team: Poster making. Individual: Practice notebook (Way of thinking about poster making).

lessons.content: Middle announcement (poster session). Evaluation, it's received, and, a design is corrected. Correction of a design point.
lessons.operation: Poster session Looking of a design plan
lessons.assignments: Team: Announcement evaluation, it's received, and, correction. Correction of a design point. Individual: Practice notebook (idea of correction by a poster session)

lessons.content: Correction with a design. Correction of a design drawing. Model making by a design drawing. Correction of a design point.
lessons.assignments: Team: Correction of a design drawing. Model making by a design drawing. Correction of a design point. Individual: Shared drawing and model making.

lessons.content: Model making by a design drawing. Poster making starting for last announcements.
lessons.assignments: Team: Model making by a design drawing. Poster making. Individual: Shared model making.

lessons.content: Model making by a design drawing. Poster making for last announcements.

lessons.assignments: Team: Team activity information upload. Individual: Practice notebook (reflection of a poster session)

lessons.content: PowerPoint form announcement by a chosen excellent team (within 6 teams). Looking and grading of the class contents. Rearranging and presentation of the presentation file. Self-check.
lessons.operation: Confirmation of results. Look back on the whole lecture.
lessons.assignments: Individual: Perform the self-check for the action of the class.
